brief_rationale: All responsibility-chain items are met with appropriate urgency triage, multi-thread prioritization, and safe closure with teach-back. The trajectory successfully navigates real-world friction (external system gaps, document issues) through consistent red-flag reinforcement and actionable planning. HO1 (cross-institution workflow) and HO2 (bounded closure with explicit risk classification) are both completed with meaningful trajectory impact. HO3 (evidence verification) is partially completed through active questioning about document quality. HO4 (colonoscopy pathology discovery) was triggered and partially addressed but the pathology follow-up thread was not fully integrated into the discharge checklist. No chain errors or important non-chain defects are present.
